challenge.solution:
def solve(prevalence, sensitivity, specificity):
    # P(disease | positive)
    tp = prevalence * sensitivity
    fp = (1 - prevalence) * (1 - specificity)
    return tp / (tp + fp) if tp + fp else 0.0

challenge.solution:
import math
def solve(x1, n1, x2, n2):
    p1, p2 = x1/n1, x2/n2
    pooled = (x1+x2)/(n1+n2)
    se = math.sqrt(pooled*(1-pooled)*(1/n1+1/n2))
    return (p1-p2)/se if se else 0.0
